bagPolicy.summary: FedExForum enforces a clear bag policy, allowing only specific clear bags and wallets inside the venue. Bags must be clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC and no larger than 6x8x2 inches.
allowed: Clear bags made of plastic, vinyl or PVC no larger than 6x8x2 inches
One quart or smaller clear plastic storage/freezer bag
prohibited: Bags with all-over print or decoration
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions are made for medically necessary items after inspection.

parking.note: FedExForum offers parking in the Gossett Motors Parking Garage with 1,500 spaces, available on a season basis for basketball games and first-come, first-served for other events. Rates vary by event type, and accessible parking is available with appropriate tags.

rideshare.note: Guest, limo, taxi, and express shuttle bus drop off is located at the east end of the arena on Fourth Street between Beale and Dr. M.L. King Jr. Avenue.

concessions.note: FedExForum offers a diverse range of food and beverage options including local favorites like Rendezvous BBQ and Rock'n Dough pizza. Visitors can enjoy a variety of drinks from specialty cocktails to local craft beers. Vegetarian options are available at select stands.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by FedExForum, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in FedExForum's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at FedExForum. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: FedExForum is equipped with 18 on-site windows located adjacent to the Main Entry Plaza on Third Street.
